goal: CD-9: Implement the pinned, safe oasdiff OpenAPI adapter defined by the completed CD-4 research/ADR. Compare a configured candidate YAML/JSON OpenAPI contract with the same repository path at an explicit baseline Git ref; validate both inputs; invoke the ADR-pinned oasdiff via argv only with read-only temporary files, bounded timeout/output, and external reference loading disabled; translate declared breaking changes into normalized Dogwatch findings containing severity, check ID, locator, message, fingerprint, and baseline/candidate provenance. Return diagnostics—not policy findings—for invalid/missing inputs and tool failures, and add deterministic automated coverage for the agreed fixture matrix including no-change, removals, requiredness, enum/constraint breaks, invalid/missing inputs, timeout/tool failure, and ignored/reclassified findings.
